name: Littlestone Cardinality Equality and Tree-Support Extremality Are Incomparable
scope: Finite Boolean concept classes; fixed coordinates are retained only where the statement explicitly refers to the displayed ground set.
proof: The rank-two ball attains Littlestone cardinality equality but has an extra adaptive global support. A proper displayed subcube is tree-support-extremal but misses the cardinality bound computed using the larger displayed ground set.
